Health & Configuration Status\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Returns service operational status, active data mode (sandbox vs fixture), dry run safety flag, and order/dispute statistics.
PayPal dispute retrieval, evidence pack compilation, and scoring
List All Disputes\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>

Retrieves all active PayPal customer disputes enriched with matched store order data,
indexed Evidence Packs, deterministic winnability scores, and live deadline calculations.
Results are sorted ascending by response deadline.
Reset Demo Dispute Database\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>
Resets mock fixture disputes back to their initial active state (6 active disputes, clearing test concessions/refunds).
Get Single Dispute Details\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Fetches full details for a specific dispute, including its store order match, evidence pack facts, score breakdown, and cached AI analysis.
Grounded defense drafting and citation analysis via Gemini
Generate or Refresh Gemini AI Defense Analysis\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Invokes Google Gemini to evaluate the dispute and Evidence Pack.
Produces structured JSON containing strategic recommendation (FIGHT / ACCEPT / PARTIAL_OFFER),
summary, and a factual draft defense strictly citing Evidence Pack fact IDs ([F1], [F2]).
Validates all citations against the Evidence Pack and caches the output locally.
Merchant-approved PayPal dispute actions (evidence submission, claim acceptance, settlement offers)
Submit Evidence to PayPal\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Submits merchant evidence statement to PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/provide-evidence`).\nIf `DRY_RUN=true`, validates and logs the payload in the audit trail without modifying live account state.\n
Accept Dispute Claim\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Concedes liability and accepts the customer claim via PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/accept-claim`).\nAuthorizes full refund to buyer. If `DRY_RUN=true`, validates and records action without sending network mutation.\n
Propose Partial Settlement Offer\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">POST\x3C/span>

Submits a partial refund settlement offer to the buyer via PayPal Disputes API v1 (`POST /v1/customer/disputes/{id}/make-offer`).\nIf `DRY_RUN=true`, validates offer amount and records action in audit trail without live mutation.\n
Chronological merchant action logging and audit trail
Retrieve Merchant Audit Trail\x3C!-- --> \x3Cspan class=\"font-mono font-medium text-green-600 dark:text-green-400 ms-auto text-xs text-nowrap\">GET\x3C/span>
Returns the chronological, immutable log of merchant actions, submitted evidence statements, and settlement decisions.
